name: Ñamandu / Ñande Ru

domain_history.domain: eternal, self-originating creator figure per Mbyá-Guaraní tradition (León Cadogan's Ayvu Rapyta material, informant Cacique Pablo Vera) — creates himself from his own divine wisdom (kuaarara), then creates the sacred/creative word (ayvu/ñeʼẽ) and, through it, the cosmos

notes: Named regional/dialectal variants exist and should not be presented as one uniform figure across all Guarani subgroups: Ñanderu, Ñamandú, Ñamandú Ru Eté (Mbyá orthography, the best-sourced form in this batch); Nhanderuvuçu, Nhamandú, Nhandejara (Brazilian-Portuguese renderings, likely Nhandeva/Chiripá-adjacent groups, not independently verified this research pass). See claim_namandu_tupa_contested_status for the documented, separate figure Tupã and the scholarly correction of its popular "Tupã = God" conflation.
